items.a: SoundBridge offers ongoing ensemble programs and seasonal music intensives. Visit our Programs page for current opportunities.
Our programs currently serve students ages 5–18, with age ranges varying by program.

items.q: Do students need prior music experience?
items.a: Some programs welcome complete beginners, while others require prior instrument experience. Each program page explains its requirements.

items.q: How do I register for a program?
items.a: Visit the program page and select Register Now, or contact us for the registration form and next steps.

items.q: What if a program is full?
items.a: We maintain a waitlist for full programs. Contact us to be added.
Yes. Need-based scholarships are available, and no student is turned away due to cost.

items.q: Is there a payment plan option?
items.a: Yes. Contact us to discuss flexible payment options.

items.q: What is the Chamber Music Camp?
items.a: It is a five-day summer intensive where string students receive coaching, play in small ensembles, and perform for the community.
Yes. The week concludes with a performance for families and community members.
SoundBridge makes high-quality music education accessible throughout the Saginaw Bay community.
You can donate, volunteer, partner, sponsor a program, teach, or refer students.
